$comment: Plain-language explanations for the stats, modifiers and ability properties the theorycraft tool shows. Written in our own words from the API's own data.

groups.health: Changes how much health you have, or how quickly it comes back.
groups.spirit: Changes spirit power and how far your abilities reach.
groups.weapon: Changes your gun and your melee.
groups.defence: Changes how much damage you take, and from what.
groups.ability: Changes ability cooldowns, charges, durations and ranges.
groups.movement: Changes how fast you move, and how far.
groups.sustain: Heals you or your allies, and steals health.
groups.utility: Changes the odds of something useful happening.
groups.unmapped: This property could not be matched to a known stat in the Atlas.

health.label: Max Health
health.what: How much health you can take before you die.
health.affects: More health means you survive longer. It does not heal you.

spirit.label: Spirit Power
spirit.what: Your ability power. Spirit damage is computed from it.
spirit.affects: Scales spirit damage and some ability effects.

weapon.label: Weapon Damage
weapon.what: The damage your gun and your melee deal.

spiritResist.label: Spirit Resist
spiritResist.what: Reduces the spirit damage you take.

bulletResist.label: Bullet Resist
bulletResist.what: Reduces the bullet damage you take.
bulletResist.affects: Only helps against bullets and melee.

moveSpeed.label: Move Speed
moveSpeed.affects: Getting to a fight sooner, and retreating from one.

cooldown.label: Cooldown Reduction
cooldown.what: Shortens how often your abilities are available.

modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_HEALTH_MAX_PERCENT: Adds a percentage of your maximum health.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_BASE_HEALTH_PERCENT: Adds a percentage of your maximum health.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_OUT_OF_COMBAT_HEALTH_REGE: Heals you faster when you are not in a fight.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_BULLET_LIFESTEAL: Heals you for a share of the bullet damage you deal.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_TECH_LIFESTEAL: Heals you for a share of the spirit damage you deal.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_BARRIER_HEALTH: Adds to the health of barriers you create.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_TECH_POWER: Adds spirit power, which scales your spirit damage.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_TECH_POWER_PERCENT: Adds a percentage of your spirit power.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_TECH_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER: Multiplies the spirit damage you deal.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_IMBUED_BONUS_DAMAGE: Adds spirit damage while an imbue is active.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_TECH_RANGE_PERCENT: Extends the range of your abilities.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_TECH_RADIUS_PERCENT: Extends the radius of your abilities.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_TECH_RESIST: Reduces the spirit damage you take.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_TECH_RESIST_REDUCTION: Reduces spirit resistance others apply to you.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_MELEE_RESIST: Reduces the melee damage you take.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_STATUS_RESISTANCE: Makes you harder to stun, silence, root or disable.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_BULLET_ARMOR_DAMAGE_RESIS: Reduces the bullet damage you take.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_BULLET_AND_MELEE_RESIST_R: Reduces bullet and melee resistance others apply to you.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_BULLET_RESIST_NON_HERO: Reduces bullet damage you take from creeps and non-heroes.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_WEAPON_POWER: Adds to the damage your gun and melee deal.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_WEAPON_DAMAGE_INCREASE: Increases the damage your gun and melee deal.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_BULLET_DAMAGE_INCREASE: Increases the damage your bullets deal.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_CLOSE_RANGE_WEAPON_DAMAGE: Increases your damage at close range.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_BONUS_WEAPON_DAMAGE_CLOSE: Increases your damage between two distances.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_BONUS_BULLET_DAMAGE_LONG_: Increases your bullet damage past a minimum distance.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_LONG_RANGE_BULLET_DAMAGE_: Increases your bullet damage at long range.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_WEAPON_DAMAGE_TO_NPC_INCR: Increases your damage against creeps and non-heroes.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_AMMO_CLIP_SIZE: Adds to the size of your magazine.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_AMMO_CLIP_SIZE_PERCENT: Adds a percentage to the size of your magazine.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_BONUS_ATTACK_RANGE_PERCEN: Extends the range at which your shots connect.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_ALL_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIER: Multiplies all the damage you deal.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_MELEE_DAMAGE_INCREASE: Adds to the damage your melee deals.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_COOLDOWN_REDUCTION_PERCEN: Shortens every ability cooldown by this percentage.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_ITEM_COOLDOWN_REDUCTION_P: Shortens the cooldown of your items.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_ULTIMATE_COOLDOWN_REDUCTI: Shortens your ultimate cooldown by this percentage.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_PARRY_COOLDOWN_REDUCTION_: Reduces the time before you can parry again.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_BONUS_ABILITY_DURATION_PE: Extends how long your abilities last.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_BONUS_ABILITY_CHARGES: Adds charges to abilities that have them.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_ENABLE_CHARGES: Gives abilities charges they did not have.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_MOVEMENT_SPEED_WHILE_SHOO: Reduces the speed you lose while shooting.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_MOVEMENT_SPEED_WHILE_ZOOM: Reduces the speed you lose while zoomed in.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_MOVEMENT_GROUND_DASH_REDU: Shortens the cooldown of your ground dash.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_MOVEMENT_SLIDE_DISTANCE_S: Makes your slide carry you further.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_AIR_MOVE_DISTANCE_INCREAS: Makes your jumps and dashes carry you further.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_AIR_CONTROL_PERCENT: Gives you more control in the air.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_AIR_CONTROL_ACCEL_PERCENT: Makes you accelerate faster in the air.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_STAMINA: Adds stamina to dash and sprint.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_RESPAWN_TIME_ADDITIVE: Adds to how long you wait to respawn.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_RESPAWN_TIME_PERCENTAGE: Adds a percentage to how long you wait to respawn.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_ZOOM_INCREASE_PERCENT: Extends how far you can zoom.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_MOVE_SPEED_LIMIT: Raises the speed cap on your movement.
modifiers.MODIFIER_VALUE_INVALID: This modifier is not recognised by the Atlas and may be disabled or removed.

cssClasses.tech_damage: Adds to the spirit damage an ability deals.
cssClasses.bullet_damage: Adds to the bullet damage you deal.
cssClasses.damage: Adds to the damage you deal.
cssClasses.melee_damage: Adds to the damage your melee deals.
cssClasses.duration: Changes how long an ability lasts.
cssClasses.cast: Changes how quickly an ability casts.
cssClasses.range: Changes how far an ability reaches.
cssClasses.distance: Changes how far you can travel.
cssClasses.clipsize: Changes the size of your magazine.
cssClasses.slow: Applies or changes a slow effect.

AbilityCooldown.what: How many seconds before the ability can be used again.

AbilityDuration.what: How many seconds the ability lasts.

AbilityCastRange.what: How far you can target with the ability.

AbilityCharges.what: How many times you can use the ability before it recharges.

AbilityCooldownBetweenCharge.what: How long you wait between charges.

Damage.what: How much damage the ability deals.
Damage.affects: Spirit power scales this when the API gives a coefficient.

SlowDuration.what: How many seconds the slow lasts.

StunDuration.what: How many seconds the stun lasts.

AbilityResourceCost.what: How much of your resource the ability costs.
AbilityResourceCost.affects: A cheaper ability can be used more often.

AbilityUnitTargetLimit.what: How many targets the ability can hit at once.
AbilityUnitTargetLimit.affects: A higher limit hits more targets per cast.

base.what: The ability's value before upgrades or items.

tier.what: The value after the ability's upgrade tier.
tier.affects: Each tier adds its own bonuses to the base value.

items.what: The value with your items and spirit power applied.
items.affects: Includes the tier and build changes. Computed from the build, not read from the game.

max_health.what: How much health you can take before you die.
max_health.affects: More health means you survive longer.

base_health_regen.what: Health regenerated out of combat per second.
base_health_regen.affects: Heals over time when not taking damage.

ooc_health_regen.affects: Additional regen when not in combat.

tech_range.what: Base range for your spirit abilities.
tech_range.affects: Larger values mean abilities reach farther.

tech_duration.what: Base duration for your spirit abilities.
tech_duration.affects: Larger values mean effects last longer.

weapon_power.what: Spirit Power / Weapon Power base value.
weapon_power.affects: Scales spirit damage and some effects.

light_melee_damage.what: Damage dealt by your light melee.

heavy_melee_damage.what: Damage dealt by your heavy melee.

reload_speed.what: How fast you reload your weapon.

max_move_speed.affects: Movement speed in meters per second.

move_acceleration.what: How quickly you reach top speed.

stamina.what: Stamina available for dashes and movement.
stamina.affects: Limits how often you can dash.

air_dash_distance_in_meters.affects: How far you can dash in the air.

air_dash_duration.affects: How long the air dash lasts.

ground_dash_distance_in_meters.affects: How far you can dash on the ground.

ground_dash_duration.affects: How long the ground dash lasts.

ability_resource_max.affects: Pool for abilities that use a resource.

ability_resource_regen_per_second.affects: Regenerates your ability resource over time.

proc_build_up_rate_scale.affects: Affects how quickly status effects build up.

FallSpeedMax.what: Maximum fall speed for this ability.
FallSpeedMax.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

MaxFallSpeed.what: Maximum fall speed for this ability.
MaxFallSpeed.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

AirSpeedMax.what: Maximum air speed for this ability.
AirSpeedMax.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

AirDrag.what: Air drag applied while this ability is active.
AirDrag.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

VerticalDrag.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

FallingDrag.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

AirDampingDuration.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

AirJumpForce.what: Force applied for an air jump.
AirJumpForce.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

AirJumps.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

AirJumpVerticalSpeedPercent.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

AirDashDistancePercent.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

AirSideMoveSpeedPercentage.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

AirSpeedBonus.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

GravityScale.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

EnemyDragSpeed.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

ChargeDragVerticalOffset.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

JuggleAirSpeedMax.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

JuggleFallSpeedMax.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

BombFriction.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

Friction.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

FrictionPercentage.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

GroundFrictioNpercentage.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.

DashAirSpeed.affects: This is ability-tuning, not changed by items.
